assets.caption: EXHIBIT 13-42 Sewer Box
assets.notes: Detailed engineering drawing of a sewer box assembly showing piping arrangement with elevations and dimensions; labels include unpaved area, paved area, vent to atmosphere (with detail reference), top of grade/engineering, precast concrete pipe (Class III), inlet elevation (see plan), invert elevation (see schedule), inside bottom elevation (see schedule), 48 in minimum, outlet, and field cut equipment; shows quarter, eighth, and sixteenth bends with slope notations.
